data.intent: Rebuild Field View's chrome around a three-pane Light Film Room shell: vertical field orientation, store-based selection model, panel registry for future initiatives, and a mobile bottom-sheet layout replacing the SmallScreenNotice block.
Selection state added to SceneStore; vertical field orientation transform in coords.ts
Light Film Room design tokens (SHELL_TOKENS) and Tailwind theme pass

data.summary: Added SHELL_TOKENS (accent #be185d, grounds #ffffff/#f4f4f5, border #d4d4d8) to render/tokens.ts
Confirmed FIELD_TOKENS/PIECE_TOKENS #EF4B8A untouched (verified via git diff and tokensGuard.test.ts)
Extended Tailwind config comments cross-referencing SHELL_TOKENS to the existing film.* palette and .film-room zero-radius scope, which already covers /fieldview
Confirmed font-heading maps to Archivo Black with no font-bold on any font-heading element repo-wide
Extended tokensGuard.test.ts with SHELL_TOKENS value assertions and FIELD_TOKENS/PIECE_TOKENS immutability assertions

SHELL_TOKENS added to render/tokens.ts (accent #be185d, grounds #ffffff/#f4f4f5, border #d4d4d8) per ADR-6; existing FIELD_TOKENS/PIECE_TOKENS (#EF4B8A) verified byte-identical via git diff and a new tokensGuard.test.ts assertion block. Tailwind config and index.css comments cross-reference SHELL_TOKENS to the film.* palette and .film-room zero-radius/font-heading setup that already existed from an earlier encyclopedia tweak and already covers /fieldview (Layout.tsx wraps it). Full fieldview suite 256/256 green, tsc clean, production build clean.
data.canon_entry: fieldview module gains a documented SHELL_TOKENS export in render/tokens.ts (shell-chrome only) alongside FIELD_TOKENS/PIECE_TOKENS (game-entity visuals); the two are an intentional two-accent system (#be185d chrome vs #EF4B8A entities) per ADR-6, not an oversight.
data.notes_for_evaluator: Judgment call: rather than declaring a duplicate shell-* Tailwind color namespace, this partition confirmed the pre-existing film.* palette (base/panel/border/accentPink) already matches ADR-6 exactly and already scopes to /fieldview via Layout.tsx .film-room, so it documented the reuse instead of adding parallel colors. Same for zero-radius (.film-room * already sets border-radius:0 globally under Layout) and font-heading/no-font-bold (already shipped in the prior field-view-ux tweak). No SHELL_TOKENS.spacing or typography sub-object was added since ADR-6 scopes the token addition to accent/grounds/border; spacing/typography are already Tailwind-only concerns with no existing TS analog in FIELD_TOKENS/PIECE_TOKENS to mirror.
